description: React component for a notifications page in a Next.js application, managing notification fetching, display, and user interactions.

methods.name: relativeTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable relative time string from a date string.

methods.name: handleMarkRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read and refreshes notifications.

methods.name: handleMarkAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read and refreshes.

methods.name: getActorAndAction
methods.description: Determines the actor and action description based on notification type.

methods.name: getRightIcon
methods.description: Returns an icon component based on notification type.
